summary: Expose optional host seat admission and accepted-pending seat starts

replay.detail: Admission observations are process-local and are never replicated as graph claims or overlaid on historical status.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or claim changes.

rules.detail: Optional host admission queues new seats; authorized replacements retain their replacement admission reason and internal gate runners are excluded.

compatibility.detail: Current status and health expose seatAdmission. Agent detail/list expose seat_admission; accepted start JSON includes seatAdmission. Missing metadata remains compatible with older daemons.

manual.detail: Use agents start/show/ls for pending reason and queue position. Doctor JSON exposes host mode, reason, pendingCount and oldestPendingAgeSecs under performance.seatAdmission.

recovery.detail: Pending admission is not a failed or running provider; restarting the daemon rebuilds process-local admission state from current declarations.
